query:
INSERT INTO system_prompts.session_prompts
                        (session_id, request_id, lane, blocks, content_sha256)
                     SELECT $1, $2, 'main', $3, $4
                     WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                         SELECT 1 FROM system_prompts.session_prompts
                         WHERE session_id = $1 AND lane = 'main'
                     )
